text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder collapses during training.
I rush her
to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for that embarrassing
display.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I wasn't. But I thought I could push
through it
for a single training session.
choice_data_list: Have you been feeling sick since t...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect this... Training will have
to be put
on hold for the foreseeable
future, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer... please see to your work.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You're really not going to leave, are
you?
choice_data_list: I'll keep an eye on things here un...
Let's take a quick rest and make u...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes... Yes, I suppose you're right.
choice_data_list: I am a Trainer, after all.
I am a Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't have to see me in such a
miserable
state.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spend time in the infirmary with a
depressed
Grass Wonder until she feels
better.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: All right. Thank you for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder seemed a little on edge,
so I give
her some time alone to
recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to be just sitting
here...
Why did
this have to happen?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear how upset she is, even from the
other side
of the infirmary's door.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. We seem to be so in sync
that I
couldn't help but laugh.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. I'll commit myself to
recovery
and be back to full strength in
no time. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's recovery takes a while.
But once she's back on her feet, she
remains true to her
word and makes up
for lost time.
